messages:
sara: Heads-up from the nightly evals — the q4 quantized llm-13b run with last night's runtime patch is producing a lot of short/truncated answers on short_qa. Repro rate ~12% vs ~0.5% baseline. Logs attached.

deploy-bot: :rocket: rolled eng/runtime@8a9f2b3 (fused_attention_v2 + sampler refactor) at 1778200000

omar: I can repro locally. Command below with seed=42 gives repeated tokens and premature EOS. Observed KL and perplexity spikes on that prompt subset.

kevin: Which commit is that exactly? link?

sara: 8a9f2b3 — PR https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/4521. Main changes: fused_attention_v2, per-shard RNG in Sampler, slight reorder of sampling loops to improve throughput.

mike: Quick hypothesis: RNG seeding change made sampler deterministic across shards/batches, causing correlated draws -> stuck tokens.

omar: Repro steps I used:
```
python evals/run_eval.py --model llm-13b-q --config quant=q4_0 --seed 42 --prompt-set short_qa --n 2000
```
Ran on a single GPU. Setting temp=0.8 shows the issue more than temp=0.2.

kevin: I ran with the old attention (use_old_attn=true) and the outputs match baseline. So fused_attention_v2 alone might not be the full story, but sampler+attn interplay looks suspect.

omar: Also tried forcing top_k=50 at runtime and failure rate drops to ~1.1% — suggests sampling tail handling changed.

sara: I'll add a unit-test that fails deterministically and attach it to the PR. Minimal test will check for repeated EOS or >3 identical token repeats in first 64 tokens for the short_qa prompts.

mike: Short-term mitigation: add rng_reset_per_request (reset thread_local RNG with request_id) and revert per-shard persistent RNG. I'll open a quick PR.

kevin: Please include a reproducer script in tests/integration/ that runs with q4_0 quant config. Also capture logits and sampling decisions to inspect probabilities.

omar: I dumped logits for one failing request — there's a very spiky distribution where a single token gets 0.72 mass after fusion, baseline had ~0.18. Something in KV cache or masking maybe.

sara: Good catch. Could be fused attention ordering touching KV cache indices. I'll run with KV cache disabled to isolate.

mike: Filed a ticket: INF-1234 and linked the nightly eval alert. Adding a temporary regression alert to #eng-runtime-alerts.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: https://issues.internal/INF-1234 — "short outputs after fused_attention_v2 + sampler refactor"

kevin: Plan: 1) bisect sampler vs attention by toggling each change 2) add deterministic unit test 3) if confirmed, revert RNG change and land smaller perf fix 4) re-run nightly and monitor.

sara: I'm starting the bisect now. Will post minimal failing input and test result in this thread. Thanks all. :eyes:
